_meta.notes: Group 5 v2 refresh. All previously null fields for D5IU, BMGU and XZL filled by extracting binary SGXNet PDFs with pipeline/extract_pdf.cjs. UIBU, M1GU and AW9U re-sourced to issuer IR PDFs (investor.ai-reit.com, firstreit.listedcompany.com, ir.uibreit.com) plus, for UIBU, the SGXNet IPO prospectus pages. Added property_yield_pct (= NPI / total portfolio fair value at the same balance-sheet date) and gearing_pct_incl_perps (= (total borrowings + perpetual securities outstanding) / total assets) for the two REITs with live perpetuals (D5IU). UIBU is the new IPO (12 Mar 2026); IPO prospectus dated 5 Mar 2026 remains the canonical source. (1) UIBU: post-IPO occupancy reported as 92.2% via 7 May 2026 manager release (occupancy uplift); IPO prospectus 89.4% retained for headline since post-IPO release URL not surfaced and IPO prospectus is the prospectus-level canonical figure for FY2026 forecast. (2) M1GU: 1Q 2026 Business Update SGXNet PDF (16 Apr 2026) successfully extracted; FY2025 results PDF (13 Feb 2026) used for NAV and FY2025 NPI. NAV per unit S$0.53 confirmed from FY2025 presentation. (3) D5IU Landmark REIT: FY2025 results PDF AND 1Q 2026 presentation (29 Apr 2026) both extracted; 1Q 2026 numbers preferred (gearing 40.22% vs FY2025 43.54%, occupancy 87.5%, WALE 2.8 years by NLA). NAV per unit S$0.0265 post rights issue. Perpetuals: S$140m + S$120m = S$256.8m outstanding; distributions suspended. (4) AW9U First REIT: 1Q 2026 Business Update SGXNet PDF (23 Apr 2026) and accompanying presentation extracted. Perpetuals fully redeemed in Jan 2026; no perpetual securities outstanding as at 31 Mar 2026. FY2025 NPI S$97.3m / portfolio S$1,022.7m used for property yield. (5) BMGU BHG Retail REIT: FY2025 results PDF (27 Feb 2026) AND 1Q 2026 Business Update PDF (28 May 2026) both extracted; 1Q 2026 used for gearing 40.8%, WACE 4.3%, ICR 1.7x, WALE 2.1 yrs GRI; FY2025 used for NAV S$0.68 per unit and NPI S$29.030m / portfolio S$859.162m. (6) XZL Acrophyte Hospitality Trust: FY2025 Results Presentation PDF extracted; NAV US$0.69 per stapled security, gearing 42.8%, WACE 6.4%, ICR 1.6x, occupancy 69.4%, portfolio US$714.9m, NPI US$37.1m. No perpetuals.
